QuestInfo.name: [Commerci Republic] Gilberto's Reaction
QuestInfo.0: Gilberto's reaction earlier was troubling you. Did he think you were a liar? Leon looked like he had an opinion about that.
QuestInfo.2: Gilberto's reaction earlier was troubling you. Did he think you were a liar? Leon said you were over-thinking things and suggested you stay the night.\r\nNot a bad idea, but Gilberto's reaction still lingered on your mind.
